versions.changelog:
Initial release: Instantly open Grok AI by xAI in Brave browser with your voice.

- Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux
- Simple trigger phrases like "open grok" or "launch grok"
- Takes you directly to https://grok.x.ai, ready for chat
- Requires Brave browser, X/Twitter login, and Grok subscription
- Helpful troubleshooting guide included
